mapper.select: SELECT s.id FROM appointment_slot s JOIN doctor_schedule sc ON sc.id = s.schedule_id WHERE sc.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND sc.schedule_date = #{date} AND sc.status = 'OPEN' AND s.start_at < #{end} AND s.end_at > #{start} FOR UPDATE
SELECT a.id FROM appointment a JOIN appointment_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id WHERE s.schedule_id = #{id} AND a.status IN ('BOOKED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'VISITED') FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id FROM appointment a JOIN appointment_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id WHERE a.status IN ('BOOKED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'VISITED') AND s.end_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
